mapper.select:
select WEEW.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, '08' as entrustStatus, WEEW.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, WEEW.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, FPT.TYPE_9 type6, FPT.TYPE_10 type7, WEEW.ENTRUST_DATE entrustDate, WEEW.PS ps, WEEW.ENTRUST_AMT entrustAmt
from WFL_ETR_ENTRUST_WW WEEW INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON FP.FINPROD_ID = WEEW.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FPT.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID
WEEW.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}
and WEEW.FINPROD_ID LIKE concat('%',concat(#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
AND WEEW.ENTRUST_DATE >=to_date(#{startDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND WEEW.ENTRUST_DATE <=to_date(#{endDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and WEEW.PS = #{ps}
union all
select WEW.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, WEW.ENTRUST_STATUS as entrustStatus, WEW.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, WEW.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, FPT.TYPE_9 type6, FPT.TYPE_10 type7, WEW.ENTRUST_DATE entrustDate, WEW.PS ps, WEW.ENTRUST_AMT entrustAmt
from ETR_ENTRUST_WW WEW INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON FP.FINPROD_ID = WEW.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FPT.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID
WEW.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}
and WEW.FINPROD_ID LIKE concat('%',concat(#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
AND WEW.ENTRUST_DATE >=to_date(#{startDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND WEW.ENTRUST_DATE <=to_date(#{endDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and WEW.PS = #{ps}

select fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, nvl(fp.FINPROD_ABBR,fp.FINPROD_NAME) text, fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, fp.FINPROD_ID col
from FIN_PRODUCT fp INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FPT.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID
fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F17') and FPT.TYPE_10 = 'N004'
AND (fp.FINPROD_ID LIKE concat('%',concat(#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) OR fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE concat('%',concat(#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')))
AND fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{initValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, fp.FINPROD_ID hidCode, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID code, nvl(fp.FINPROD_ABBR,fp.FINPROD_NAME) shortName
from FIN_PRODUCT fp
fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F01','F10','F06','F18','F37')
AND (fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE concat('%',concat(#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) OR fp.FINPROD_NAME LIKE concat('%',concat(#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')))

select fp.FINPROD_TYPE2, fpt.TYPE_9 TYPE_6, fpt.TYPE_10 TYPE_7, fpt.TYPE_8, fp.FINPROD_ABBR, fp.FINPROD_ID col, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, nvl(fp.FINPROD_ABBR,fp.FINPROD_NAME) text
from FIN_PRODUCT fp left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fp.FINPROD_ID = fpt.FINPROD_ID
fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F01','F10','F18','F06','F37')
AND (fp.FINPROD_ID LIKE concat('%',concat(#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) OR fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE concat('%',concat(#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')))
AND fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{initValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select ITEM_CODE id, ITEM_VALUE "text" from SYS_DATADICT_LIST
DICT_CODE = #{dictCode}

select psp.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, sum (psp.AMOUNT) as subjectNum from PTL_SEC_POSITION psp,PTL_PORTFOLIO pp
psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID and psp.FINPROD_ID = #{portfolioIdChange} and psp.CDATE = to_date(#{entrustDate},'yy/mm/dd') and psp.BRANCH = '0' and psp.HODING_TYPE = '03' having sum(psp.AMOUNT)>0 GROUP by psp.PORTFOLIO_ID,pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME order by sum (psp.AMOUNT)

select portfolioId,portfolioName,PORTFOLIO_AMT,subjectNum from (
select ppt.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, ppt.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, eewd.PORTFOLIO_AMT as PORTFOLIO_AMT, ppt.AMOUNT subjectNum
from ETR_ENTRUST_WW_DETAIL eewd inner join ETR_ENTRUST_WW eew on eewd.ENTRUST_ID = eew.ENTRUST_ID
inner join ( select psp.PORTFOLIO_ID, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME, psp.FINPROD_ID, sum (psp.AMOUNT) AMOUNT
from PTL_SEC_POSITION psp inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID where psp.FINPROD_ID = #{portfolioIdChange} and psp.BRANCH = '0' and psp.HODING_TYPE = '03'
and psp.CDATE = to_date(#{entrustDate},'yy/mm/dd')
GROUP by psp.PORTFOLIO_ID,pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME,psp.FINPROD_ID ) ppt on ppt.PORTFOLIO_ID = eewd.PORTFOLIO_ID
where eew.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}
and eewd.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
UNION all
select ppt.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, ppt.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, eewd.PORTFOLIO_AMT as PORTFOLIO_AMT, ppt.AMOUNT subjectNum
from WFL_ETR_ENTRUST_WW_DETAIL eewd inner join WFL_ETR_ENTRUST_WW eew on eewd.ENTRUST_ID = eew.ENTRUST_ID
inner join ( select psp.PORTFOLIO_ID, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME, psp.FINPROD_ID, sum (psp.AMOUNT) AMOUNT
from PTL_SEC_POSITION psp inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID where psp.FINPROD_ID = #{portfolioIdChange} and psp.BRANCH = '0' and psp.HODING_TYPE = '03'
and psp.CDATE = to_date(#{entrustDate},'yy/mm/dd')
GROUP by psp.PORTFOLIO_ID,pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME,psp.FINPROD_ID ) ppt on ppt.PORTFOLIO_ID = eewd.PORTFOLIO_ID
where eew.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}
and eewd.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
) order by subjectNum
